title: Security Oracles - a new approach to active Smart Contracts security

ms.promise:
(A) Research report detailing identified smart contract vulnerabilities and challenges.
(B) Architecture outline for the Security Oracle framework and a detailed plan for this PoC project.
(C) API Specification for off-chain monitoring systems (this work package was part of milestone 2 in the original proposal, it was moved to this milestone to avoid what would be a too large 2nd milestone. respective budget and timing was moved as well)
ms.criteria:
(A) Research report includes an analysis of at least 5 documented vulnerabilities or security challenges to Cardano's smart contract environment.
(B) An architecture outline of the proposed approach should include a component and a data flow diagram as well as a brief description of the various components. the detailed project plan should account for the described architecture
(C) API specification for the off-chain monitoring system should provide a clear definition of the functionality of monitoring systems
ms.report:
https://github.com/gammer13/pcf11-security-oracles/blob/main/Milestone1/Report/milestone_report.pdf
The above is the milestone report containing two chapters - 
・Overview of Cardano Smart Contract security - discussing the current state of smart contract security , presenting 5 key vulnerabilities and one important incident where these vulnerabilities may have been exploited, and finally presenting our new active approach to smart contract security.
・Describing the PoC projects including the architecture of the proposed solution and a project plan

The second artifact is a yaml file with the API specifications for potential off-chain threat intelligence system, the file specifies the API endpoints that should be implemented by such systems in order to interact with security oracles - 
https://github.com/gammer13/pcf11-security-oracles/blob/main/Milestone1/monitoring_system_api_spec.yaml

ms.promise:
(A) PoC implementation of a smart contract using the security oracles with a mock monitoring system. (This work package was carried over from the second milestone in the original proposal to account for milestone size limitations)
(B) Report detailing multiple potential approaches for developing off-chain Security Monitoring Systems, and identifying critical benchmarks such as transaction throughputs, data freshness, and optimal response times.
(C) Analysis of diverse business models suitable for fostering the creation and adoption of these systems.
ms.criteria:
(A) The smart contract implementation should demonstrate the use of Security Oracles within a "client" smart contract and revert a transaction based on information coming from the the mock monitoring system
(B) The report should encompass a comprehensive exploration of at least three potential approaches for developing off-chain Security Monitoring Systems, providing insights into their technical feasibility, advantages, and challenges. 
(C) Analysis of various business models, considering factors such as incentivization mechanisms, sustainability, and potential stakeholders' involvement.
